name: David Sacks
office: Co-chair, President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (former White House AI and Crypto Czar)
stance: Pushes federal preemption of state AI laws and accuses safety-focused labs of using catastrophic-risk arguments for regulatory capture.

statements.text: sophisticated regulatory capture strategy based on fear-mongering
This was in response to a growing patchwork of 50 different state regulatory regimes that threaten to stifle innovation and jeopardize America's lead in the AI race.
Left the AI and crypto czar post at the 130-day special-government-employee limit and became co-chair of PCAST with Michael Kratsios.
